subject.title: Suppress model fallback notices in rooms

question: Should model fallback and recovery diagnostics remain visible only in direct chats, with group and channel rooms receiving no user-facing notice?
rationale: Current documentation establishes visible operational notices but not their room-delivery policy; this PR deliberately changes existing shared-room behavior and the correct privacy-versus-operator-observability tradeoff requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt direct-chat-only notices
options.body: Approve suppression in group and channel rooms, retain lifecycle diagnostics, and require refreshed real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Retain room notices
options.body: Keep the current delivery behavior if shared-room operators are expected to receive fallback and recovery status directly, then close this PR as a policy mismatch.

recommendation.title: Adopt direct-chat-only notices
recommendation.body: Approve suppression in group and channel rooms, retain lifecycle diagnostics, and require refreshed real behavior proof before merge.
